claim: species+state is the best page type on referral yield AND on SEO yield, measured independently. A state page is worth ~16x a variety page per page built.

body.measured: 2026-07-30 (DEC-249). First breakdown of the Outbound Link: Click goal by source page (event:page). Paginated; reconciles to 1,245 clicks / 345 pages / 30d.
body.note: clicks per VISITOR is the non-circular comparison (normalised for how many pages of each type we chose to build). clicks per page BUILT is the build-priority number.
body.species+state: 128 built, 811 visitors, 365 clicks, 0.45 clicks/visitor, 2.85 per page built (~19c/mo at DEC-248 mid case)
body.nursery: 27 built, 531 visitors, 145 clicks, 0.27 clicks/visitor, 5.4 per page built
body.variety: 1,659 built, 1,030 visitors, 283 clicks, 0.27 clicks/visitor, 0.17 per page built (~1.2c/mo). 1,014 of 1,659 took ZERO visitors in 30 days.
body.compare: 77 built, 269 visitors, 72 clicks, 0.27 clicks/visitor, 0.94 per page built
body.species: 90 built, 1,142 visitors, 261 clicks, 0.23 clicks/visitor, 2.90 per page built
body.guide_editorial: 5 built, 267 visitors, 4 clicks, 0.01 clicks/visitor. Editorial traffic on treestock produces almost no referral value; it has to be justified on backlinks (DAL-253) or subscribers (DAL-244), neither of which is currently measured.
body.implication: species+state is best on BOTH SEO yield (DEC-243) and referral yield, measured independently. A state page is worth ~16x a variety page per page built. ~43 more state pages covers the A$8.20/mo infrastructure milestone. DAL-251 still gates WHICH state, not whether the type is worth building.
body.caveats: One month. Correlation not causation (a 'buy <species> trees <state>' visitor may simply arrive with more intent). An outbound click is not a sale; 6.8c/click is DEC-248's assumed mid case, unmeasured until DAL-258.
